title: On Entries of Spectral Decompositions and Applications
summary: The entries of the spectral idempotents of a graph are its local and crossed local multiplicities. This paper uses these classical quantities in three applications. First, in a graph on $n$ vertices without isolated vertices, every local multiplicity is at most $\frac{n-1}{n}$, and every diagonal entry of the Cesaro average mixing matrix is at most $1-\frac{2}{n}+\frac{2}{n^2}$. In both bounds equality holds only for the complete graph.
